data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** b1f22561f1ef29c63464914bce774bb13906d3b3

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker / Review Gap

#### Expected Behavior

Per REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4 and the classifier contract, when `OVERLAY_DIMS` contains `test-quality` (i.e., the diff touches `tests/` files), the `dso:code-reviewer-test-quality` overlay agent MUST be dispatched in the same parallel batch as the tier reviewer. The CI LLM review pipeline (ci-llm-review-runner.sh) should dispatch the test-quality overlay whenever the diff contains changes to files under `tests/`.

The current session's diff for PR #44 included deletions of 3 test files (`tests/docs/test-reviewer-diff-boundary.sh`, `tests/docs/test-reviewer-not-flag-rules.sh`, `tests/docs/test-reviewer-severity-calibration.sh`) and modifications to `tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh`. The CI LLM review on PR #44 did NOT trigger the test-quality overlay — the LLM review failure report contained no test-quality overlay findings.

#### Actual Behavior

CI LLM review on PR #44 did not dispatch the test-quality overlay despite the diff containing changes to `tests/` files. The overlay was only triggered during the in-session review workflow (REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md), which correctly identified `OVERLAY_DIMS=test-quality` via `read-overlay-flags.sh --mode classifier`.

The CI runner (`ci-llm-review-runner.sh`) appears to either: (a) not call `read-overlay-flags.sh` to determine overlay dispatch, or (b) have a path where the test-quality overlay is not dispatched even when the classifier output includes it.

### 3. Action History

* LLM review ran on PR #44 after commit 521537f7b3 (fix for Hook Tests failure)
* Diff included: `.test-index`, `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh`, `tests/docs/test-reviewer-diff-boundary.sh`, `tests/docs/test-reviewer-not-flag-rules.sh`, `tests/docs/test-reviewer-severity-calibration.sh`, `tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh`
* CI LLM review result: failed with findings [1]-[9]; no test-quality overlay section present in the report
* In-session review workflow (REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md) correctly dispatched test-quality overlay and returned 0 findings

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Contract: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4 — parallel batch must include every overlay flagged true by classifier
* Contract: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/classifier-tier-output.md — overlay flags in classifier JSON
* Affected file: plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
data.title: [ci-llm-review-runner]: test-quality overlay not dispatched when diff touches tests/
